title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: There is an integer array `nums` sorted in ascending order (with distinct values) that is rotated at an unknown pivot. Given the array `nums` and an integer `target`, return the index of `target` if it is in `nums`, or `-1` if it is not in `nums`. Algorithm must run in O(log n) time.

hints.content: At least one half (left or right) of the array is always normally sorted.
Check if target lies within the boundaries of the sorted half.
If target is within sorted half, search there; otherwise search the other half.

solution.explanation:
Identify which half is sorted, then determine if the target lies within that half.
Time Complexity: O(log n)
Space Complexity: O(1)
